name_en: Interest-free crop loans through Co-operative Societies (Kisan Credit Card - Crop Loan)
department: Co-operation Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: Your village co-operative society gives you a short-term crop loan at 7% interest. If you repay on or before the due date, you pay no interest. The Government pays it for you. You need no security up to Rs 2 lakh. The loan is partly cash and partly fertilizer, pesticide and seeds.

other: Tenant farmers and landless farm workers can also get crop loans.
To pay no interest, you must repay on or before the due date.

where_to_apply: Your Primary Agricultural Co-operative Credit Society (PACCS)
